typography.family: IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono
typography.style: institutional ledger — mono for every id, code, hash and stat; sans for prose

patterns: trace-strip: the G0-G5 gate pipeline rendered as a literal node sequence with pass/fail dots and a dashed connector where a decision short-circuited

must: show real benchmark and audit data
retain readable table layout on narrow screens
reserve the decision-status colors (allow/step-up/quarantine/deny) exclusively for verdicts, never for chrome or links
avoid: cyan or neon accents of any kind

decisions: Use a dense, light operational dashboard with a charcoal top bar and status-specific accents; prioritize decision inspection, review work, and measurable security posture.

Institutional ledger identity: IBM Plex Sans/Mono pairing, deepened/desaturated status quartet, single non-cyan indigo-violet interactive accent (--signal) kept strictly apart from all four decision colors.
Signature element is the gate-trace strip on the decision detail page: the architecture's own G0-G6 pipeline diagram turned into a functional, literal UI component rather than a decorative one.
